The dependency has to be replaced with org.neo4j:neo4j-ogm-bolt-driver and you need to configure a Bolt url like bolt://localhost:7687 or use the new neo4j:// scheme, which takes care of routing, too.
items.translation: 您已添加 `org.neo4j:neo4j-ogm-http-driver` 并配置了类似 `user:password@localhost:7474` 的 URL。 该依赖需要替换为 `org.neo4j:neo4j-ogm-bolt-driver`，并且您需要配置一个 Bolt URL，例如 `bolt://localhost:7687`，或使用新的 `neo4j://` 方案，后者也能自动处理路由。

items.source: Both @EnableBookmarkManagement and @UseBookmark as well as the org.springframework.data.neo4j.bookmark.BookmarkManager interface and its only implementation org.springframework.data.neo4j.bookmark.CaffeineBookmarkManager are gone and are not needed anymore.
items.translation: @EnableBookmarkManagement 和 @UseBookmark，以及 org.springframework.data.neo4j.bookmark.BookmarkManager 接口及其唯一实现类 org.springframework.data.neo4j.bookmark.CaffeineBookmarkManager 已被移除且不再需要。

items.source: @Index, @CompositeIndex and @Required have been removed without replacement. Why? We think that creating the schema - even for a schemaless database - is not part of the domain modelling. You could argue that an SDN model is the schema, but than we would answer that we even prefer a Command-query separation, meaning that we would rather define separate read and write models. Those come in very handy for writing "boring" things and reading graph-shaped answers.
items.translation: @Index、@CompositeIndex 和 @Required 已被移除且无替代方案。 原因何在？ 我们认为，即使对于无模式数据库，构建模式也不属于领域建模的范畴。 有人可能会争辩说 SDN 模型本身就是模式，但我们的回答是：我们甚至更倾向于采用命令 - 查询分离原则， 这意味着我们更愿意定义独立的读写模型。 这些模型在编写“枯燥”的操作以及读取图形化结果时非常实用。

items.translation: 您已在项目中添加了 org.neo4j:neo4j-ogm-embedded-driver 和 org.neo4j:neo4j，并通过 OGM 设施启动了数据库。 此方式已不再受支持，您需要配置标准的 Neo4j 服务器（同时支持独立部署和集群模式）。

items.source: Configuring SDN through a org.neo4j.ogm.config.Configuration bean is not supported, instead of, all configuration of the driver goes through our new Java driver starter. You will especially have to adapt the properties for the url and authentication, see Old and new properties compared

items.source: SDN uses bookmarks for all transactions, without configuration. You can remove the bean declaration of CaffeineBookmarkManager as well as the dependency to com.github.ben-manes.caffeine:caffeine.

items.source: We think it’s better to take control about this upfront and recommend using controlled database migrations, based on a tool like Liquigraph or Neo4j migrations. The latter has been seen in use with SDN inside the JHipster project. Both projects have in common that they store the current version of the schema within the database and make sure that a schema matches expectations before things are being updated.
items.translation: 我们认为，最好从一开始就掌控局面，并推荐使用受控的数据库迁移工具，例如 Liquigraph 或 Neo4j 迁移。后者已在 JHipster 项目中与 SDN 配合使用过。这两个项目的共同之处在于，它们都将当前模式的版本存储在数据库中，并在执行更新之前确保模式符合预期。

items.source:
SDN+OGM has had quite a history over the years and we understand that migrating big application systems is neither fun nor something that provides immediate profit.
The main issues we observed when migrating from older versions of Spring Data Neo4j to newer ones are roughly in order the following:
items.translation:
SDN+OGM 多年来经历了一段不平凡的发展历程，我们深知迁移大型应用系统既非易事，也无法立即带来收益。
在将旧版本的 Spring Data Neo4j 迁移到新版本时，我们观察到的主要问题大致如下：

items.source:
While Neo4j-OGM can be used stand-alone, Spring Data Neo4j cannot.
It depends to large extend on the Spring Data and therefore, on the Spring Framework itself, which eventually affects large parts of your application.
Depending on how the application has been structured, that is, how much the any of the framework part leaked into your business code, the more you have to adapt your application.
It gets worse when you have more than one Spring Data module in your application, if you accessed a relational database in the same service layer as your graph database.
Updating two object mapping frameworks is not fun.
items.translation: 虽然 Neo4j-OGM 可以独立使用，但 Spring Data Neo4j 则不行。它很大程度上依赖于 Spring Data，进而依赖于 Spring Framework 本身，这最终会影响您应用程序的大部分组件。根据应用程序的结构方式——即有多少框架部分泄露到了业务代码中——您需要对应用程序进行相应调整的程度也会有所不同。如果您的应用程序中包含多个 Spring Data 模块，并且在同一服务层中同时访问关系型数据库和图数据库，情况会更加糟糕。更新两个对象映射框架绝非易事。

items.source:
The embedded database in a SDN+OGM project is configured by Neo4j-OGM.
Say you want to upgrade from Neo4j 3.0 to 3.5, you can’t without upgrading your whole application.
Why is that?
As you chose to embed a database into your application, you tied yourself into the modules that configure this embedded database.
To have another, embedded database version, you have to upgrade the module that configured it, because the old one does not support the new database.
As there is always a Spring Data version corresponding to Neo4j-OGM, you would have to upgrade that as well.
Spring Data however depends on Spring Framework and then the arguments from the first bullet apply.
items.translation:
在 SDN+OGM 项目中，嵌入式数据库由 Neo4j-OGM 进行配置。
如果您希望将 Neo4j 从 3.0 版本升级到 3.5 版本，则必须对整个应用程序进行升级，无法单独完成此操作。
这是为什么呢？
由于您选择将数据库嵌入到应用程序中，因此您的应用与配置该嵌入式数据库的模块紧密耦合。
若要使用另一个版本的嵌入式数据库，就必须升级配置它的模块，因为旧版本模块不支持新版本的数据库。
由于始终存在与 Neo4j-OGM 相对应的 Spring Data 版本，因此您也必须对其进行升级。
然而，Spring Data 依赖于 Spring Framework，此时第一点中提到的限制条件同样适用。

items.source:
Migrating from the embedded solution is probably the toughest migration, as you need to set up a server, too.
It is however the one that gives you much value in itself:
In the future, you will be able to upgrade the database itself without having to consider your application framework, and your data access framework as well.
items.translation:
从嵌入式解决方案迁移可能是最具挑战性的迁移，因为您还需要搭建服务器。  
然而，这也是能为您带来最大价值的一种方案：  
未来，您将能够独立升级数据库本身，而无需考虑您的应用程序框架以及数据访问框架。

items.source: Once you have made sure, that your SDN+OGM application works over Bolt as expected, you can start migrating to SDN.
items.translation: 一旦确认您的 SDN+OGM 应用程序通过 Bolt 按预期运行，即可开始迁移至 SDN。

Apart from that, some of those annotations respectively their values are tied to specific Neo4j editions or versions, which makes them
hard to maintain.

items.source:
The best argument however is going to production: While all tools that generate a schema are indeed helpful during development, even more so with databases that enforces a strict scheme,
they tend to be not so nice in production: How do you handle different versions of your application running at the same time?
Version A asserting the indexes that have been created by a newer version B?
items.translation: 然而，最好的论证在于生产环境：虽然所有生成模式的工具在开发阶段确实很有用，尤其是对于强制严格模式的数据库而言，但在生产环境中它们往往并不那么友好：当不同版本的应用程序同时运行时该如何处理？例如，版本 A 断言由更新版本 B 创建的索引是否存在？

items.source: Backed by those observations, we recommend to make sure you’re using only the Bolt or http transport in your current application before switching from SDN+OGM to SDN. Thus, your application and the access layer of your application is to a large extent independent of the database’s version. From that state, consider moving from SDN+OGM to SDN.
items.translation:
基于上述观察，我们建议在从 SDN+OGM 迁移到 SDN 之前，确保您的当前应用程序仅使用 Bolt 或 http 传输。  
这样一来，您的应用程序及其访问层在很大程度上将独立于数据库的版本。  
在此状态下，可以考虑从 SDN+OGM 迁移到 SDN。

items.source: You cannot configure SDN through XML. In case you did this with your SDN+OGM application, make sure you learn about annotation-driven or functional configuration of Spring Applications. The easiest choice these days is Spring Boot. With our starter in place, all the necessary bits apart from the connection URL and the authentication is already configured for you.
items.translation: 无法通过 XML 配置 SDN。 如果您曾使用 SDN+OGM 应用程序进行此操作，请确保您已了解 Spring 应用程序的注解驱动或功能式配置方式。 目前最简便的选择是 Spring Boot。 借助我们的启动器，除了连接 URL 和认证信息外，所有必要的配置均已为您设置完毕。

items.translation: 这些新属性在未来可能会再次发生变化，届时 SDN 和驱动程序将最终完全取代旧版配置。
